email.subject: Mainline Group Plumbing site is losing calls
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I looked at Mainline Group Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: it isn't mobile-friendly, so most people searching for a plumber on their phone struggle to even load it, and there's no click-to-call button, so those same mobile visitors can't tap to ring you and probably just call the next plumber in Harbor Falls instead.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's broken and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
